visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The opening phase presents a vibrant pink and white floral background overlaid with the large red and blue Costco Wholesale logo. A small cartoon male character with a surprised expression is positioned on the left side of a pink banner. Large white and pink Chinese text fills the center, indicating a weekly special report for February 10th to 16th. Bright, saturated lighting enhances the festive promotional atmosphere. (2) The sequence shifts to a warehouse setting with high industrial shelves. Stacks of Kleenex toilet paper in purple packaging and Arm & Hammer cat litter in orange and blue boxes are displayed prominently. The camera performs a slight push-in on the products. Bright white text overlays specify price reductions. The flooring is polished concrete, and the lighting is even, bright studio-grade supermarket illumination. (3) The scene transitions to the refrigerated section. Plastic-wrapped trays of Australian French lamb chops are neatly arranged in silver metal cooling racks. The meat is bright red with white marbling. Large yellow and red text highlights a 200-dollar discount. The background shows other meat products and the clean, white interior of the refrigerated display case with overhead fluorescent lighting. (4) A rapid montage of snack and candy aisles follows. Packages of shredded squid, Snickers minis, almond crisps, and Bee Cheng Hiang beef jerky are shown stacked in their original shipping cartons. The camera captures these from a medium shot perspective, often slightly handheld. Colorful packaging dominates the frame, complemented by bold variety-show style text detailing specific prices and savings. (5) The focus moves to the beverage and pantry section. Glass jars of colorful fruit candies, tubes of Pringles, boxes of Bisco biscuits, and elegant Godiva chocolate boxes are showcased. The items are neatly stacked on warehouse pallets. Text overlays continue to pop up in the center-right of the screen, identifying brands and promotional prices against the backdrop of the vast, high-ceilinged warehouse environment. (6) The video highlights alcoholic and fresh items. Bottles of Glenmorangie whiskey in orange boxes, Bernini sparkling wine, and containers of Kuze Fuku snacks appear. This is followed by close-ups of fresh black grapes, blueberries in plastic clamshells, and bags of white potatoes. The lighting remains bright and natural for a retail space, emphasizing the freshness and quantity of the produce on display. (7) The final phase features dairy, frozen, and health products. Stacks of banana milk, Yakult, and large tubs of yogurt are shown in refrigerated units. This is followed by bags of dumplings, boxes of Starbucks coffee, and large containers of Quaker oats. The video concludes with packs of Always sanitary pads and Centrum vitamin bottles. The camera uses quick cuts to maintain a fast rhythm, with price text consistently appearing on the right.

visual_scene_and_style.backgroundDescribe: The background consistently features the interior of a Costco warehouse. High industrial metal shelving units are visible, filled with bulk-packaged goods and original shipping cartons. Refrigerated glass cases and open cooling units for meat and produce are also shown. The environment is spacious with a utilitarian, warehouse-style aesthetic.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a high-energy male narrator introducing the Costco weekly specials. His voice is bright, with high arousal and a friendly, sales-oriented tone. Background music (BGM) consists of a driving electronic pop beat at approximately 128 BPM, featuring synthetic percussive textures and a stable major mode. No ambient noise is present, indicating a studio recording. (2) As the visuals transition through household items like toilet paper and cat litter, the narrator maintains a rapid speech rate, enunciating each product name and price with precision. The BGM continues steadily in the background, providing a rhythmic pulse that matches the fast visual editing. A subtle 'ding' sound effect occasionally punctuates the price reveals. (3) The middle phase focuses on a long list of snacks and beverages. The narrator's pitch variability is high as he emphasizes the discount amounts. The interplay between his excited vocal delivery and the upbeat synthesizer melody creates a sense of urgency and excitement. The speech density is extremely high, with almost no pauses between mentions of items like Snickers and Pringles. (4) In the section covering fresh produce and alcohol, the narrator's tone remains professional yet enthusiastic. He seamlessly moves from describing grapes to whiskey. The BGM maintains its consistent volume and energy level, never overshadowing the primary vocal signal, which remains clear with high fidelity and strong harmonic clarity. (5) The final phase covers pantry staples and health supplements. The narrator's intensity remains consistent until the very end of the recording. The rapid-fire delivery concludes without a final outro, ending abruptly on the mention of vitamins. The overall production is a hyper-dense social-media style edit where the audio track is precisely synced to the rapid visual cuts.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a high-speed informational advertisement designed to showcase a large volume of discounted products available at Costco within a specific timeframe. By using rapid visual cuts, high-energy narration, and constant price comparisons, it aims to create a sense of 'FOMO' (fear of missing out) and encourage immediate shopping trips among its target audience.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The entire video is dedicated to promoting specific products and brands currently on sale at Costco Wholesale.
